entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so confused by the website and the whole process.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your name and the order number?
My name is Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF88602. It's for the cycling shoes I bought.
Thank you, Sarah. I'm pulling that up now. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know. They just don't feel right. I tried them on my bike once and they gave me terrible blisters. And I can't figure out the cleats at all. I just want to send them back for a refund. The policy pages are so overwhelming... Can't you just help me?
Of course, I'm here to help make this easy for you. Let me just confirm the delivery date... I see the shoes were delivered to you 20 days ago, on December 23rd.
Yes, that sounds right. Is that a problem? I was so worried I missed the window.
Not a problem at all. For standard items like these cycling shoes, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! Thank you so much. I was so stressed about it.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Simply pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off with the postal service. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
That's perfect. Thank you, David. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
